name: Blechtechnik Aichbauer GmbH
summary: Blechtechnik Aichbauer is a family-owned sheet-metal shop (founded 1982, 70 staff, about 7.5 M EUR turnover). It is our 100% single source for the welded, painted base frame HN 50/65. Its performance has fallen four quarters in a row, from amber to red (OTD 70.4% to 63.0%, ppm 1197 to 4118), and our Supplier Quality sent a formal escalation on 2026-09-24. Two weeks earlier it asked us to pay within 10 days in exchange for a cash discount, which signals a need for liquidity.

situation.decision_maker: Likely the owner / managing director (family GmbH, 70 staff, no group parent). The dossier does not name a contact.

negotiation_pattern: It opens with modest asks and settles below them. Three renewals: asked -2.2% and settled -6.0%; asked +2.2% and settled 0.0%; asked +3.6% and settled 0.0%. On average it asked +1.2% and settled -2.0%. It has always given in under pressure and has never received an increase. Its latest move came unprompted: it offered a cash discount in return for 10-day payment.
wants: Faster payment (10 days, offered with a cash discount); we currently pay late 95% of the time, on average 6 days after due
Keeping the A-part volume (we are 11.3% of its turnover, about 0.85 M EUR a year)
A price increase for 2027 (its asks in the last two rounds were +2.2% and +3.6%)
Continuity of the framework agreement beyond 2027-06-30
protects: chargeback_eur_per_complaint (currently a flat EUR 150; it will resist a higher fee)
ppm_commitment (it will avoid binding numeric ppm targets given its current 4118 ppm)
unit_price downward, only moderately (past settlements show it does concede)

trades.give: payment_days down from 45 net to 10 days, with a cash discount, plus a commitment to pay on time
trades.get: A cash-discount percentage clearly above our cost of money, plus a binding ppm_commitment and an OTD improvement plan with milestones
trades.why: This is its own explicit request and costs us little. It is our strongest lever and should be tied to quality.

trades.give: contract_months: extend the framework beyond 2027-06-30, conditional on reaching green
trades.get: unit_price held flat (0%) for 2027 and a ppm/OTD glide path back to the 95% OTD target
trades.why: It wants volume security. Making the extension conditional on performance protects our sole supply.

trades.give: volume_per_year: confirm current volume and keep the 100% quota while it improves
trades.get: chargeback_eur_per_complaint raised above the flat EUR 150, and cost recovery for the quality failures
trades.why: Only EUR 750 has been recharged for 7 complaints and 35 parts in 12 months, which is far below our real cost.

arguments.point: The scorecard has worsened every quarter: OTD 70.4% to 63.0% and ppm 1197 to 4118. It is now red and class C, against a contractual 95% OTD target. A price increase is not justifiable at this level.
Supplier Quality has formally escalated and expects a binding improvement plan. Our commercial terms will follow its performance.
We own the tooling for part:330010, so resourcing is feasible if it does not improve.
Prices are fixed per calendar year. Any 2027 change needs written notice at least 90 days before year end, which means by about 2026-10-02. A late request is not contractually valid.
We can accept its own proposal of fast payment for a cash discount, but only within a package that includes quality commitments.

avoid: Granting fast payment on its own, without tying it to ppm/OTD commitments and a price hold
Accepting any 2027 price increase while the scorecard is red
Squeezing cash so hard that it puts at risk our only source for an A-part (equity ratio 24.1%)
Continuing to pay late. It undermines our credibility on performance demands.
Humiliating, purely punitive language toward a family owner. Keep pressure firm but fair.
tone: Firm, factual and performance-focused. Acknowledge the long relationship and its cash-discount offer, and make every concession conditional on measurable quality and delivery improvement.
red_flags: Single source with a 100% quota and no other approved source, so a quality collapse or supplier failure would stop production
ppm has more than tripled in 12 months and OTD keeps falling, with no sign of a turnaround yet
The request for 10-day payment may point to liquidity strain (equity ratio 24.1%, credit index 232, stable but not strong)
Our own late payments (95% late) weaken our position and may add to its cash stress

evidence.claim: Red scorecard: OTD 63.0%, 4118 ppm, 7 QNs, score 60.9, class C
Supplier asked for 10-day payment in exchange for a cash discount
Contract: 45 days net, OTD target 95%, EUR 150 per complaint, prices fixed per year with a 90-day notice period
Price history: settled 0.0% against a +3.6% ask and 0.0% against a +2.2% ask; earlier settled -6.0%
Framework agreement runs to 2027-06-30 and extends automatically by 12 months unless terminated with 90 days' notice

indicators.credit_index: 232 (12 months ago 232; higher is worse, >300 weak)
